reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text:
Five years ago, this week, the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act was signed into law.

From improving @SEPTAPHILLY and @PHLAirport to modernizing Philadelphia’s water system, this law has brought billions in investments back to our city. I proudly fought to pass this https://t.co/kCaovMYqdr

59,000 combat veterans currently are being robbed of their full retirement and disability.

Today, House Democrats forced a vote and passed the Major Richard Star Act to right this injustice and give our veterans their all EARNED benefits. Now the Senate must do the same! https://t.co/j4p5Dkaj6n

This Veterans Day, let's not only celebrate and honor the sacrifices and accomplishments of our nation’s veterans, but continue working to ensure that all our veterans receive the care and benefits they have earned.

That's why I’m fighting alongside my House Democratic https://t.co/4iH7nSmgry

Secretary Pete Hegseth has repeatedly broken the law and endangered the lives of our servicemembers. I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again — Pete Hegseth must go!

If President Trump won’t act, Congress must. I’ll be voting to impeach.

This administration continues to find new lows.

They should be helping lower the high cost of groceries, not kicking even more people off a program that helps them put food on the table.
https://t.co/nnDnkIjI5s

I was proud to join @HabitatPhilly at their groundbreaking in Germantown today!

Throughout my career, I’ve been proud to work with Habitat for Humanity to expand affordable housing across Philadelphia. https://t.co/tDsNIiDDnQ

As always with Trump, watch what he DOES, not what he says.
 
He just appointed the architect of ICE and CBP’s cruelty and mass deportations to be his chief of staff.
https://t.co/5Z0GDCMlM2

Happy Diwali to everyone celebrating in Philadelphia and beyond! 
 
May this festival of lights bring joy, peace, and new beginnings to you and your loved ones. https://t.co/CcSGywGOuX

Hey Philly! Make sure to protect yourself and your loved ones this upcoming holiday season by getting your annual flu shot and COVID vaccine. 
 
You can get vaccinated for FREE, with no appointment needed, at Philadelphia Health Centers right in your neighborhood! Learn more here:
https://t.co/MvTftVN9AL

Americans have the right to protest peacefully. 

But targeting businesses because they're Jewish-owned is antisemitism. Doing so on the eve of Kristallnacht makes it even more appalling. 

I condemn that discrimination and I thank Mayor Parker and the Philadelphia Police Department for the actions they are taking to maintain public safety.
